meta.title: Cjenik i sidrena cijena demo shop
meta.description: WooCommerce with a few products, a sale, an anchor price and one published price list.
meta.author: Meridian d.o.o.

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
foreach ( array(
	'blogname' => 'Demo trgovina',
	'timezone_string' => 'Europe/Zagreb',
	'permalink_structure' => '/%postname%/',
	'woocommerce_store_address' => 'Ilica 150',
	'woocommerce_store_city' => 'Zagreb',
	'woocommerce_store_postcode' => '10000',
	'woocommerce_default_country' => 'HR',
	'woocommerce_currency' => 'EUR',
	'woocommerce_currency_pos' => 'right_space',
	'woocommerce_price_decimal_sep' => ',',
	'woocommerce_price_thousand_sep' => '.',
	'woocommerce_coming_soon' => 'no',
	'woocommerce_onboarding_profile' => array( 'skipped' => true ),
) as $name => $value ) {
	update_option( $name, $value );
}
flush_rewrite_rules();
// Land on the price list status page, not WooCommerce's setup.
delete_transient( '_wc_activation_redirect' );
$products = array(
	array( 'Kava mljevena 500 g', '6.40', '', '3850000000011', 5.99 ),
	array( 'Maslinovo ulje 1 l', '12.00', '9.90', '3850000000028', null ),
	array( 'Čokolada 100 g', '1.99', '', '3850000000035', null ),
);
foreach ( $products as [ $name, $regular, $sale, $gtin, $anchor ] ) {
	$product = new WC_Product_Simple();
	$product->set_name( $name );
	$product->set_sku( 'DEMO-' . substr( $gtin, -3 ) );
	$product->set_global_unique_id( $gtin );
	$product->set_regular_price( $regular );
	$product->set_sale_price( $sale );
	$product->set_status( 'publish' );
	$product->save();
	if ( null !== $anchor ) {
		cjenik()->anchors()->set( $product->get_id(), $anchor, '2026-09-10', 'manual' );
	}
}
cjenik()->settings()->update( array( 'wizard_done' => true ) );
cjenik()->scheduler()->publish_all();
